_note: Transposed from OpenAIResponsesAdapter.parseResponse. Two collect rules walk the SAME output[] array: the first applies to every item whatever its type (output files, hosted builtin-tool calls), the second switches on the type. Splitting them changes no result -- each accumulator still fills in item order -- and it is the only way to express 'this happens for all of them, and then this happens for some of them'.

reasoningItems._note: Scaffolding, never a response field: a program item cannot be sent back without the reasoning items that preceded it in the same output.

finalize._note: The output_text convenience field, only when no message produced text and nothing else landed in content. UNEXERCISED: none of the 16 recorded Responses-API bodies carries `output_text`, and deleting this rule leaves the whole differential green. openai-ts documents it as the property to use 'where supported in SDKs' -- it is computed client-side, not returned on the wire. Kept because it transposes the adapter faithfully, but it is defensive code for a shape the HTTP API does not appear to send, and it is a deletion candidate for both paths at once.
